data.name: Fallen Immortal Expanse
data.detailed_description:
"Life is not like a dream. Every choice leads to a different outcome, and even regret is unique."

Fallen Immortal Expanse aims to create a free, fantastical cultivation world where, through exploration and making different choices, you can quickly live out the lives of various characters in the realm of cultivation.

As this is a solo indie project with limited resources, the game will inevitably fall short in some aspects. I sincerely apologize for that, but I will do my best to improve based on your feedback.

A Fictional Cultivation World – The Nine Provinces

The game begins in a self-evolving cultivation world. You start as a mortal or a rogue cultivator and rise through multiple paths. As you travel across different regions, you advance your cultivation realm, gather techniques, magical treasures, and spirit pets, and befriend rogue cultivators or members of various factions. If you become powerful enough, your choices will influence the direction of the world.

Free and Open Paths to Cultivation

The game offers many ways to grow stronger: alchemy, artifact forging, merchant trading, killing for loot, rogue trading, body refining, demonic cultivation, and more. You can choose the methods you are good at and enjoy, then put your skills to the test against challengers at the same realm.

Faction Conflicts and Strategic Intrigue

As you travel through the Nine Provinces, you will meet key figures of this world, learn about its past and present, observe their calculations and ambitions, and interact with them. At each stage of your cultivation, your choices determine what you gain – and who will walk alongside you as fellow Daoists.

Semi-Real-Time Combat with Multiple Schools

Inspired by the magic duels in cultivation anime, the combat system features diverse schools: Five Elements, Overwhelming Force, Body Refining, Treasure Master, Beast Taming, and more. The other cultivators you face may also be masters of these schools – to defeat them, you must find the right approach from many possibilities.

Combat is presented in 3D, blending strategic turn-based planning with real-time action. You experience the thrill of live combat, yet you can pause at any moment to rethink and adjust your tactics.

data.short_description: No spiritual root – can you still ascend? In Luoxian Yang, five elements, demonic, and heretic cultivators walk their own paths. Play as mortal or novice – grow, advance. Master arts, refine treasures, recruit Daoists. Witness the Nine Provinces' struggles – shape their endings.
